\section{CLIP-based State Consistency Evaluation}
\label{sec:clip_eval}
We report state consistency using CLIP by comparing image embeddings against text embeddings derived from ground-truth state descriptions. In the object-phrase mode, each step is decomposed into five main object/state phrases (e.g., ``shimmering oil'', ``intact yolk''). If fewer than five valid phrases are available, the final score is the average cosine similarity across the available phrases.
